heroTitle: Write content with Gem, ship it fast
heroSubtitle: File-based routing, layouts, i18n, server-side rendering and static generation for Gem web components.
featureRoutingDesc: Every file in src/pages is a route. Nested _layout files keep their state across navigation.
featureSSRDesc: Pages are rendered on the server and hydrated on the client. Static routes are prerendered at build time.
featureI18nDesc: Drop JSON files into src/locales and every route is available under a language prefix.
aboutContent: This is an example of gemkit. The whole page you are reading was rendered on the server, then the Gem elements took over on the client without re-rendering.
